name: CLV Edge — Single Side
signal_logic: Generate an own projected spread, compare to the market line, and bet only when the projected spread beats the closing line by a pre-declared edge; rank by CLV.
inputs: Team stats, standings, injury/depth impact, market line
validation_gate: G-01 CLV, G-02 Sample size, G-03 Out-of-sample

name: Total Model — Single Total
signal_logic: Project total points from offensive and defensive efficiency stats adjusted for injury/depth, then take the side that beats the closing total.
inputs: Offense/defense stats, injury/depth impact, market total
validation_gate: G-01 CLV, G-02 Sample size, G-03 Out-of-sample

name: Moneyline Value — Single ML
signal_logic: Compute projected win probability, compare to implied probability from the moneyline, and take value only where projected probability exceeds implied by the edge threshold.
validation_gate: G-01 CLV, G-02 Sample size, G-03 Out-of-sample

name: Uncorrelated Parlay Builder
signal_logic: Combine multiple single-bet signals into a parlay only where the legs' computed correlation is below a pre-declared bound, so combined edge is not distorted by correlated outcomes.
inputs: Single-bet signals, computed correlation matrix, market parlay odds
validation_gate: G-01 CLV, G-04 Correlation bound, G-05 Leg independence, G-03 Out-of-sample

name: Cross-Market Parlay (Side + Total)
signal_logic: Pair a side signal with a total signal from the same game only when their correlation is acceptable; otherwise exclude to avoid double-counting the same game risk.
inputs: Side signal, total signal, correlation matrix, market odds
validation_gate: G-04 Correlation bound, G-05 Leg independence, G-01 CLV

name: Passing-Yards Prop Signal
signal_logic: Project a QB/WR passing-yards total from passing efficiency and opponent defense adjusted for injuries/depth, then bet the prop side that beats the closing prop line.
inputs: Player/team passing stats, opponent defense, injury/depth impact, prop line
validation_gate: G-01 CLV, G-02 Sample size, G-03 Out-of-sample

name: Rush + Receiving Prop Combo
signal_logic: Combine a RB rushing-yards prop and a WR receiving-yards prop from the same offense only where correlation is bounded; otherwise treat as separate single props.
inputs: Rush/receiving projections, correlation matrix, prop lines
validation_gate: G-04 Correlation bound, G-05 Leg independence, G-01 CLV

name: Injury-Driven Line Move
signal_logic: Detect a confirmed starter ruling-out, compute the expected line movement from the backup deficiency, and bet the direction the market has not yet fully priced.
inputs: Injury report, depth chart, market line movement
validation_gate: G-01 CLV, G-06 Data integrity, G-03 Out-of-sample
status: designed — pending live line + depth feed

name: Selective High-Conviction Slate
signal_logic: Rank all candidate signals by conviction edge and take only the top-N per slate, enforcing selectivity to reduce variance and focus on skill.
inputs: All candidate signals, conviction scores, selectivity cap
validation_gate: G-01 CLV, G-07 Selectivity, G-03 Out-of-sample
